player_prompt.intro:
Yaa ngone ci keppu Tower of Hanoi ak {num_disks} kepp.
Ngone naa dem kepp yi ci kepp A ba ci kepp C.
Ngone dem kepp, bindaala kepp bu jëkkër ak kepp bu ñaareel (naka-jekk, '[A C]').
Xam ne ngone mën naa dem kepp bu kaw kepp, te kepp bu réy mënul bàyyi ci kepp bu ndaw.
Ci beneen tànn, indi kepp keneen.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Yaa ngone bàyyi ak '[source] [target]' bu baax.
invalid_move.invalid_tower: Danga jox ab bérab bu amul benn njariñ walla genn màggat.
invalid_move.empty_tower: Dinga jéem a génne ab disk ci benn taax bu amul nit.
invalid_move.same_tower: Dinga jéem a yóbbu benn disk ci biir màggalu kër gi.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Dinga jéem a teg disk bu mag ci kaw disku bu ndaw.

outcome.win: Ngërëm, dangeen a xëy li ñuy wax "Tour de Hanoi".
outcome.turn_limit: Limite bu tànn bi dàq na. Yaa ngone bàyyi {pct}% ci kepp yi ci kepp C.
